# Best slim Qi2 / MagSafe power banks for iPhone 17

**Top pick for slimness: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim), $54.99**
- It's 0.34" thick and 4.3 oz, with 5,000mAh and Qi2-certified 15W wireless charging. Anker lists it as a fit for the iPhone 17 series.
- 9to5Mac says it's the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery and runs cooler than the competition.
- [Buy at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank). Source: [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/).

**Best slim with more capacity and speed: INIU SnapGo Air 10,000mAh, about $43-49**
- It's 0.5" thick and 195g, with Qi2.2 25W wireless charging (the iPhone 17 supports the full speed) and 45W wired charging.
- It includes a lanyard-style 60W cable. Android Central calls it great value, and Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K bank it tested.
- Android Central shows $42.99 at Amazon. The [Android Central review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge) has the buy links.
- Macworld notes it has no kickstand ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)).

**Thinnest and lightest, but slow: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5,000mAh), $52.99-$69.99**
- It's 0.27" thick and 104g, the slimmest in Android Central's test. Wireless charging tops out at 7.5W, though, so it's slow for topping up quickly.
- It has 22.5W wired output as a backup. [Buy links in the Android Central review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge).

**Other options**
- **ReelCharge ReelSafe (5K, 15W, semi-solid-state), $49.99:** 0.35" thick and 119g. Same review as above.
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10K, 25W Qi2.2), $59.99, or $53.99 with code AM52:** Dealectric says it tested the code in Baseus's cart on 2026-10-24, but checkout has the final say. Thickness isn't listed, so I can't confirm it's slim. [Buy at Baseus via Dealectric (affiliate link)](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w). Source: [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w).

**How to choose**
- **Pocketable, with 15W:** Get the Anker Nano 5K. A 5K bank typically gives roughly a 60-75% recharge (Macworld).
- **A full recharge or more, still slim:** Get the INIU SnapGo Air.
- **Case compatibility:** Thick or non-magnetic cases can interfere with charging (Anker's page says cases over 2.5mm may be a problem).
